title: The Twisted Axe
description: This adds The Twisted Axe from Sneak's Blueprint Project
body:
# The Twisted Axe

A rare, cursed axe hidden within the depths of Jungle Temples — waiting for the right adventurer to claim it.

---

## What It Does

**The Twisted Axe** is a Fabric mod that adds a single powerful weapon with a unique on-hit ability.

When you strike an enemy, there is a **20% chance** to trigger the **Twisted Trap** effect — an ancient curse that binds your target in place with vines for **5 seconds**.

### Twisted Trap
**Mobs** and **Players** become completely frozen. Unable to escape the Twisted Trap as vines surround them restricting them from moving.

---

## Obtaining

The Twisted Axe is found as rare loot inside **Jungle Temple** chests — it cannot be crafted. Seek it out if you dare.
